legend: This is an easier version of the next problem. In this version, q=0$$$q = 0$$$.

A sequence of integers is called nice if its elements are arranged in blocks like in [3,3,3,4,1,1]$$$[3, 3, 3, 4, 1, 1]$$$. Formally, if two elements are equal, everything in between must also be equal.

Let's define difficulty of a sequence as a minimum possible number of elements to change to get a nice sequence. However, if you change at least one element of value x$$$x$$$ to value y$$$y$$$, you must also change all other elements of value x$$$x$$$ into y$$$y$$$ as well. For example, for [3,3,1,3,2,1,2]$$$[3, 3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2]$$$ it isn't allowed to change first 1$$$1$$$ to 3$$$3$$$ and second 1$$$1$$$ to 2$$$2$$$. You need to leave 1$$$1$$$'s untouched or change them to the same value.
You are given a sequence of integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ updates.
Each update is of form "i$$$i$$$ x$$$x$$$" — change ai$$$a_i$$$ to x$$$x$$$. Updates are not independent (the change stays for the future).
Print the difficulty of the initial sequence and of the sequence after every update.
input: The first line contains integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n≤200000$$$1 \le n \le 200\,000$$$, q=0$$$q = 0$$$), the length of the sequence and the number of the updates.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤200000$$$1 \le a_i \le 200\,000$$$), the initial sequence.

Each of the following q$$$q$$$ lines contains integers it$$$i_t$$$ and xt$$$x_t$$$ (1≤it≤n$$$1 \le i_t \le n$$$, 1≤xt≤200000$$$1 \le x_t \le 200\,000$$$), the position and the new value for this position.
output: Print q+1$$$q+1$$$ integers, the answer for the initial sequence and the answer after every update.

legend.ai: 这是下一道题的简单版本。在这个版本中，q=0$$$q = 0$$$。
如果一串整数的元素像 [3,3,3,4,1,1]$$$[3, 3, 3, 4, 1, 1]$$$ 中那样按块排列，就称它为优美序列。形式化地说，如果两个元素相等，那么它们之间的所有元素也必须相等。

我们将一个序列的难度定义为：将其变为优美序列所需修改的元素个数的最小值。不过，如果你将至少一个值为 x$$$x$$$ 的元素改为 y$$$y$$$，那么还必须将所有其他值为 x$$$x$$$ 的元素也改为 y$$$y$$$。例如，对于 [3,3,1,3,2,1,2]$$$[3, 3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2]$$$，不允许将第一个 1$$$1$$$ 改为 3$$$3$$$，同时将第二个 1$$$1$$$ 改为 2$$$2$$$。你必须保持所有 1$$$1$$$ 不变，或者将它们都改成同一个值。
给定一个整数序列 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ 以及 q$$$q$$$ 次更新。
每次更新的形式为“i$$$i$$$ x$$$x$$$”——将 ai$$$a_i$$$ 修改为 x$$$x$$$。更新并非相互独立(修改会保留到后续更新中)。
输出初始序列以及每次更新后的序列的难度。

input.ai: 接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行中的每一行包含整数 it$$$i_t$$$ 和 xt$$$x_t$$$(1≤it≤n$$$1 \le i_t \le n$$$，1≤xt≤200000$$$1 \le x_t \le 200\,000$$$)，分别表示位置和该位置的新值。

output.ai: 输出 q+1$$$q+1$$$ 个整数，分别表示初始序列的答案以及每次更新后的答案。
